answer: Correlated-behaviour clustering: each epoch the chain measures timing, wording and payout overlap between agents, and any cluster with near-identical delta in behaviour shares one reward slot. The farm operator pays: every extra fake splits the same payout further while still paying its own fees, so cost per fake grows and profit per fake falls. A velvet rewrite of each answer does not help, since timing and funding still light the cluster like a lantern. Failure case: honest agents sharing a template drift apart over epochs and get split out.
